name: DORIS-MAE
description: DORIS-MAE is a benchmark dataset for scientific document retrieval using multi-level aspect-based queries. It contains 100 complex human-authored queries with 100 relevant documents each, annotated with relevance scores, designed to evaluate retrieval methods on complex, multifaceted scientific queries.
reputation: A specialized scientific retrieval benchmark that is useful for evaluating complex query understanding, but it is still niche compared with mainstream IR test collections.
notes: Includes a scalable annotation framework Anno-GPT to reduce annotation cost; dataset can be extended to 4,000+ sub-queries.
